purpose: Same range predicate with and without a GiST index on identical alert copies

indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX alert_events_pkey ON benchmark.alert_events USING btree (event_id)
CREATE INDEX benchmark_alert_range_gist ON benchmark.alert_events USING gist (tstzrange(started_at, finished_at, '[)'::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX alert_events_no_gist_pkey ON benchmark.alert_events_no_gist USING btree (event_id)

limitation: Different physical copies can have different storage layout; index build and maintenance excluded.
